_comment: Climatiq activity IDs, each VERIFIED by a live /data/v1/estimate call. Look up alternatives in the Climatiq Data Explorer (https://www.climatiq.io/data) - never guess an ID.

fuel.note: Diesel. unit_type Weight -> weight/weight_unit. Litres are converted using 0.8375 kg/L (typical diesel density).

logistics.note: Road freight. unit_type WeightOverDistance -> weight + distance. t.km is sent as weight=1 t, distance=N km.

waste.note: Municipal waste to landfill. unit_type Weight -> weight/weight_unit.
